name: Relative Corner Threshold Is at Most Twelve
scope: Finite dismantlable ample set families with concept cardinality as the interval size.
proof: The certified inclusion $B\subsetneq Q$ has both endpoints dismantlable ample, $|Q\setminus B|=12$, and every corner of $Q$ belongs to $B$. It is therefore an admissible pair in the defining minimum.
